what: Based on the Bad Gear Meme for a Volca Cowbell, I created an FM-1 Cowbell: a 16-step sequencer playing 13 recorded cowbells, with FEVER for pitch, PRESCRIPTION to pick the sample and a giant MORE knob for ratchets. Starter samples are built in; send the full-quality set from the browser.
author: C0DED00D
sounds: own: recorded by the maker from their own Roland TR-8S and Alesis DM-10
